_readme: This is the portable format for mreddyLiftz. Settings > Routine data imports and exports it.
It is written to be readable by a human or by an AI session with zero prior context.
Only 'exercises' is really required; everything else falls back to sensible defaults.
type: bodyweight_progression (advance along 'levels') or weighted (advance current_weight_kg).
set_type: FIXED_REP (input pre-fills with goal reps) or TO_FAILURE (pre-fills with what you did last time).
hypertrophy_range: [min, max]. Hitting max on EVERY set for 'rolling_window' consecutive sessions
at the current level suggests moving up. The user always confirms; nothing auto-switches.
PRs are tracked per (exercise, level) pair, so dropping to an easier level compares against that level only.
set_plan is optional. Include it when sets are not uniform, like the pull-up below.
Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored on import.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.form_description: Dead hang start, shoulders packed down before the pull. Drive elbows to the ribs, chin clears the bar, control the negative for 2s.
exercises.notes: 5 sets: 2 unassisted to failure, then 3 band assisted at goal reps.

exercises.name: Ring dip
exercises.form_description: Rings turned out at the top, elbows tracking back not flared. Lower until shoulders sit just below the elbows.

exercises.name: Standing DB press
exercises.form_description: Standing, not seated. Glutes and abs braced so the lower back does not arch.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL
exercises.form_description: Hinge from the hip, back leg and torso forming one line. Square the hips.

exercises.name: Nordic curl negative
exercises.form_description: Hips locked out with the glutes the whole way down, no piking. Resist as slowly as possible.

core_exercises.name: Plank
core_exercises.form_description: Ribs down, glutes on, neutral neck. Log seconds in the reps field.
core_exercises.notes: Logged as seconds. Core work is not progression tracked.

core_exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
core_exercises.form_description: No swing. Posterior pelvic tilt at the top, slow return.

core_exercises.name: Side plank
core_exercises.form_description: Stack the feet, hips high, log seconds per side.
